summary: Reworks the Topics first-run progress screen: shows analyzing progress (summarizing/grouping/naming with an accessible progress bar), a 'waiting for traces' screen when automatic processing is on, progress for any busy summary run, and a failed screen with retry; the 'Your first topics are ready / Display results' step and per-facet topic counts are removed, so the page switches to results automatically when the run finishes. Drops the now-unused setupTopicCounts server query.

statements.why: UI-only change plus removal of a read-only query (topicsRouter.ts setupTopicCounts); no auth/data concern.

statements.text: Most of this change is in web/src/features/topics/TopicSetupProgressView.tsx (113 lines added, 159 removed).

The agent changed TopicPilesIllustration.tsx, TopicSetupProgressView.stories.tsx, TopicSetupProgressView.tsx, TopicsPage.clienttest.tsx, TopicsPage.tsx and topicsRouter.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: The Topics page's first-run experience changes: users now see analyzing / waiting-for-traces / failed screens, and when the first run finishes the page jumps straight to results (the 'Your first topics are ready' screen with a Display results button and per-facet topic counts is gone).
